summary: trivago N.V. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a share repurchase program authorized by its Supervisory Board in April 2026 and approved by management on May 29, 2026. The program allows repurchases of up to $20 million in ADSs, each representing five Class A shares, with timing and amount at the company's discretion. Repurchases will be executed through a broker-dealer under a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan to comply with price and volume parameters, funded from working capital. The program terminates upon reaching the aggregate limit or earlier at the company's election. This is a capital return event with no specified price or premium; watch for execution pace and any subsequent buyback authorizations.
